notes: A tap on the picture only brings the mini bar back. Play and pause belong to the round button and the big button over a still, so looking at the film can never stop it.

The music video opens on FULL HD unless another size has been chosen, and a size picked by hand is never taken away: the tab may say the picture is short of frames, but it leaves it on the size that was asked for.
A size above FULL HD that this phone cannot keep up with still steps back, but only as far as FULL HD - the automatic step no longer walks the picture down to 360p on its own.

The film plays from its own first frame to its own last: where a size has no sound of its own the song is only the sound under it, and it no longer drags the picture to its own second or stops the film when the song ends.
HD+ now sharpens the frame whenever it is being stretched to this screen, whatever size it arrived at, and the AI-tuned amounts are read from the first frame the film actually shows.
